title: One Bedroom, One Office, & The Closet Sanctuary
description: Before driving back to Alexandria for work in Tysons Corner, Dad helps Katie and Nate get situated as unofficial homeowners at the brick ranch off Military Highway that has been on their Virginia State ID cards since 2001—converting Nate's old room into their shared software office, setting up a queen bed in Katie's old room, and lining the bedroom closet with a sleeping bag and pillows that all three of them know the twins will use almost every night.
